candidate.narrative: Mechanized Brigade (north-positioned) operates in supporting sector to fix the principal defending force and reduce its freedom to interfere with the decisive maneuver. Mechanized Brigade (south-positioned) attacks to penetrate the defending belt vicinity PL AMBER, creating sufficient maneuver space and a passage for the decisive force. Tank-heavy brigade passes through the penetration and attacks to seize/control OBJ SLAM to accomplish the mission. Divisional cavalry squadron screens northern flank to provide early warning and security. Division deep operations interdict or disrupt enemy artillery and armored reinforcement capable of interfering with the decisive maneuver. Division fires suppress or isolate enemy capabilities at the decisive maneuver sector and support the maneuver/deep fight. Tank task force remains a mobile reserve, prepared first to contain a threat to the passage and, if uncommitted, to follow the main effort and block interference with its movement. Mechanized infantry team protects rear sustainment area against local threats according to the generated protection task.
